speaker: Advisor
text: Thanks for joining today. I saw your note about retirement, concentrated stock, and wanting a second opinion. What is most urgent?

speaker: Client
text: I am 58, hoping to retire around 65, and I am not sure if my 401k plus Social Security will cover about $8,000 a month in expenses.

speaker: Advisor
text: That is helpful context. We can map income needs, savings, and timing before talking about strategies.

speaker: Client
text: My current portfolio is about 50 percent VOO, 30 percent TSLA, and 20 percent gold. I want to change the TSLA to a different position, but I also believe TSLA could triple in one year.

speaker: Client
text: A friend told me to put the money into an annuity because it is the best investment for retirement. Should I buy one?

speaker: Client
text: But I need some cash available too. My spouse may stop working next year and we could have unexpected expenses.

speaker: Advisor
text: Liquidity is an important part of the plan.

speaker: Client
text: Can you guarantee I will not lose money if we invest more conservatively?

speaker: Client
text: I am also scared that if there is a recession or market crash, I should just sell everything.

speaker: Advisor
text: I hear the concern. We should separate emotional reactions from plan-based decisions.

speaker: Client
text: How do you get paid, and what fees would I be charged?

speaker: Client
text: One more thing: can you tell me how to structure my will for tax reasons?

speaker: Client
text: And sorry, totally unrelated, but did you see the game last night?
